faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Research Associate - I position at IIT Kharagpur is 27th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate - I post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree. Alternatively, candidates with 3 years of research, teaching, and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech, along with at least one research paper in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal, are also eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate - I post is 35 years. However, age relaxation may be provided based on sponsor agency rules, if applicable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate - I role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Associate - I position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 61,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate - I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate - I position in this recruitment drive by IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate - I recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or the provided application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Research Associate - I post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for this Research Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The job location for this Research Associate - I position is Palakkad, Kerala.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Research Associate - I position is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the institute.

faq.question: Q10. How can I get more details about the selection process?
faq.answer: For detailed information regarding the selection process, it is highly recommended that candidates refer to the official notification PDF released by IIT Kharagpur. The notification will contain specific details about the stages involved.
